name: exception-resolver-v2
supersedes: exception-resolver-v1 (left unchanged with its result and decision)
reason_for_change: v1 passed its thresholds but source review found two spurious resolutions (E13 S030 and S034): the matched sentence was an exception item that merely mentioned the Stand-in file, not a statement of the requirement.
honest_status: Designed after seeing v1 results on the same 12 flagged passages, so v2 is a regression check, not independent validation. The holdout is the independent test.
rule_change: A resolving sentence must be a requirement statement: it starts (after optional bullet, dash or 'or') with the gerund of one stem (Listing, Closing, Blocking) and contains 'required'. Sentences that begin with 'or', start with a different word, or are exception items do not count.

thresholds.T1: E23 S045 resolves to the single stem 'list', by S044
thresholds.T2: E15 S085 resolves to the single stem 'list', by S084
thresholds.T3: E13 S030 and E13 S034 return ambiguous
thresholds.T4: no passage in E23 resolves to close or block
thresholds.T5: every one of the 12 flagged passages gets exactly one outcome

decision_rule: Pass only if T1 to T5 all hold. Otherwise record v2 as rejected; further changes get v3.
descriptive_only: Report the outcome distribution over the 12 passages and list any resolution not covered by T1 to T3 for source review.
limits: Tuned on 12 passages from one document family
The requirement-statement form (Listing ... is required) is specific to this guide's wording
Advisory; not wired into any pipeline
